slot.brief: Two springs in series (or parallel); find the equivalent spring constant and the resulting time period of an attached mass.

stem: Two light springs of force constants $40$ N m$^{-1}$ and $80$ N m$^{-1}$ are connected in parallel between a cart of mass $3$ kg and a rigid support. For small oscillations, what are the equivalent spring constant and the time period?

verdicts.working: For parallel springs, the equivalent constant is the sum: k_eq = 40 + 80 = 120 N m^-1. The period is T = 2π√(3/120) = π/√10 s.

working:
$k_{\rm eq}=k_1+k_2=40+80=120$ N m$^{-1}$
$T=2\pi\sqrt{\dfrac{m}{k_{\rm eq}}}=2\pi\sqrt{\dfrac{3}{120}}=\dfrac{\pi}{\sqrt{10}}$ s

Independent check: For parallel springs, the equivalent constant is the sum: k_eq = 40 + 80 = 120 N m^-1. The period is T = 2π√(3/120) = π/√10 s.
solution:
For springs in parallel, $k_{\rm eq}=k_1+k_2=40+80=120\,\text{N m}^{-1}$.
$$T=2\pi\sqrt{\frac{m}{k_{\rm eq}}}=2\pi\sqrt{\frac{3}{120}}=\frac{\pi}{\sqrt{10}}\,\text{s}$$
